description:
Create, list, show and delete person files at people/<Name>.md.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list people; open only by default
  show PERSON [--json] — show one person file
  new --name NAME --category CATEGORY — create a person file
  delete PERSON -y — permanently delete a person file

Flags:
  list:
    QUERY  optional fuzzy search; results ranked by similarity
    --all  include closed people
    --json  JSON output
  show:
    PERSON  full name (filename without .md)
    --json  JSON output
  new:
    --name NAME  required; full name; becomes the filename; no '/', no leading '.'
    --category  required; professional, personal or voluntary
  delete:
    PERSON  full name
    -y, --yes  required to confirm

Examples:
  ["list", "igor"]
  ["show", "Riaz Arbi", "--json"]
  ["new", "--name", "Riaz Arbi", "--category", "professional"]

Notes:
  People are link targets for note --person and task assignees; they are not threads.
  delete is permanent and refuses without -y.
  Exit 1: person already exists, not found, empty or invalid name, delete without -y.
